'''Scumbo''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] warrior from [[Pzob/Legends|Pzob]], a member of the rival clan of the [[Skunnt]] clan.

==Biography==
Scumbo ended up burned in the snout by [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]] when Thok [[Fireball Belch|belched a fireball]].<ref name="Barely Tolerable" />

Sometime later, Scumbo had eventually arrived under [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] employ, replacing [[Gorc]]. When Thok, who was the reason why Gorc was no longer with them, learned this, he grew uncomfortable. When things got inevitably worse during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], resulting in Thok's death in a backfired ambush attempt on [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Scumbo arrived at Thok's corpse, with [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] in tow. Although he briefly sneered at him, he then started squealing the war cry to bid Thok safe passage across the Great Trough of the Stars just as Jabba's [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]], the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']], exploded around them.<ref name="Barely Tolerable" />
